0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 10th in the East) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 4th in the East) for the Magic's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Orlando 1-0 on the road, 0-2 at home, and coming off a win. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Jalen Suggs is day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision, while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Magic lost the series 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
